note: Show Node Aliases lists every URL alias for a node on its edit form, with inline Edit/Delete links for users holding core's 'administer url aliases'. It has no config, no configure route, and no permissions of its own. It reads aliases from the core path_alias entity/table (path = /node/<nid>); it never creates or edits them (core path UI does). Introspection cases seed nodes with known aliases and read them back; execution cases add or delete a path_alias for a known node, verified against the live path_alias storage.

evals.prompt: What does the Drupal show_node_aliases module add to the site, and where does a user see it?
evals.expected_output: It adds an 'Existing Aliases' details table to the node edit form (via a form alter on the core path widget) listing every URL alias pointing at that node, with each alias and its language. Core only shows one alias per node; this surfaces all of them.

evals.prompt: In show_node_aliases, what determines whether the Edit and Delete operation links appear next to each listed alias? Does the module define its own permission?
evals.expected_output: The module defines no permission of its own. The Operations column with Edit/Delete links only appears when the current user has core's 'administer url aliases' permission; the links deep-link to /admin/config/search/path/edit|delete/<id>. Users without it still see the alias list, just without operations.

evals.prompt: Where does show_node_aliases get the list of aliases for a node from, and does it create or modify aliases itself?
evals.expected_output: It reads from the core path_alias entity/table, selecting rows where path = /node/<nid>. It only reads and displays them; creation, editing and deletion all happen through core's path UI, not this module.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is an Article node titled 'sna_known_node'. Inspect the live site and report the URL alias assigned to that node.
evals.expected_output: The node sna_known_node has the alias /sna-known-alias (a path_alias whose path is /node/<nid> for that node).

evals.prompt: The Article node titled 'sna_multi_node' on this site has more than one URL alias. Inspect the live site and list all of its aliases.
evals.expected_output: sna_multi_node has two aliases: /sna-multi-one and /sna-multi-two (two path_alias entities pointing at /node/<nid>).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is an Article node titled 'sna_task_node' with no extra URL alias. Add the URL alias /sna-task-promo pointing to that node, and apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Create a path_alias whose path is /node/<nid of sna_task_node> and alias is /sna-task-promo (e.g. PathAlias::create(['path' => '/node/'.$nid, 'alias' => '/sna-task-promo', 'langcode' => 'en'])->save(), or via drush/the path UI).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the Article node titled 'sna_del_node' currently has the URL alias /sna-old-alias. Delete that alias (leave the node in place) and apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Delete the path_alias entity whose path is /node/<nid of sna_del_node> and alias is /sna-old-alias. Afterwards the node still exists but that alias is gone.
